name: Volume Single Scattering (Uniform Ray Marching with Point Light Background)
aliases: Volume Single Scattering (Uniform Ray Marching with Sphere Light Background 2)
Volume Single Scattering (Uniform Ray Marching with Sphere Light Background)
definition: Variant of uniform ray marching where the background radiance is computed using a point light model instead of a generic surface object color.
summary: Volume Single Scattering computes radiance in participating media using deterministic uniform ray marching with a point light background, differing from Monte Carlo methods by avoiding stochastic sampling.
